bigpemu_get_loaded_fnv1a64.meaning: Returns the FNV-1a 64 hash of the loaded cartridge; the sources compare it with known revisions before enabling writes.

bigpemu_get_module_handle.meaning: Returns the handle identifying this script module; bigp_init passes it to every other registration call.
bigpemu_get_module_handle.ours: implicit: a pack is one module

bigpemu_get_setting_value.meaning: Reads the current value of a registered setting into a local; for a bool setting it is 0 or 1.

bigpemu_jag_get_frame_count.meaning: Returns the number of emulated frames so far, used for timers.
bigpemu_jag_get_frame_count.todo: needs frame-count state; not a constant freeze

bigpemu_jag_m68k_bp_add.meaning: Adds a 68000 instruction breakpoint at a program counter value that runs a script handler when hit.

bigpemu_jag_m68k_get_areg.meaning: Reads a 68000 address register, used inside a breakpoint handler to find data the game is touching.

bigpemu_jag_read16.meaning: Reads a 16-bit word of Jaguar memory; used for conditional or read-modify-write cheats.
bigpemu_jag_read16.todo: conditional / read-modify-write cheats need core support in src/core/cheat.c

bigpemu_jag_read32.meaning: Reads a 32-bit long of Jaguar memory; used for conditional or read-modify-write cheats and score or password checks.
bigpemu_jag_read32.todo: conditional / read-modify-write cheats need core support in src/core/cheat.c

bigpemu_jag_read8.meaning: Reads one byte of Jaguar memory; the sources use it for conditional, compare or read-modify-write cheats.
bigpemu_jag_read8.todo: conditional / read-modify-write cheats need core support in src/core/cheat.c

bigpemu_jag_sysmemread.meaning: Copies a block of Jaguar memory into a script buffer (for example save-slot or ball data).
bigpemu_jag_sysmemread.todo: block copy / backup cheats need core support in src/core/cheat.c

bigpemu_jag_sysmemwrite.meaning: Copies a script buffer into a block of Jaguar memory (restoring data or duplicating objects).
bigpemu_jag_sysmemwrite.todo: block copy cheats need core support in src/core/cheat.c

bigpemu_jag_write.meaning: Memory write whose width is a parameter instead of fixed by the call name.
bigpemu_jag_write.todo: translate once the width is a constant; otherwise needs core support

bigpemu_jag_write16.meaning: Stores a 16-bit word into Jaguar main RAM at an even address.
bigpemu_jag_write16.ours: ADDR:VVVV segment of a cheat code

bigpemu_jag_write32.meaning: Stores a 32-bit long into Jaguar main RAM at an even address.
bigpemu_jag_write32.ours: ADDR:VVVVVVVV segment of a cheat code

bigpemu_jag_write8.meaning: Stores one byte into Jaguar main RAM at an address.
bigpemu_jag_write8.ours: ADDR:VV segment of a cheat code

bigpemu_register_event_emu_thread_frame.meaning: Registers the callback run every emulated frame; the sources apply their memory writes there.
bigpemu_register_event_emu_thread_frame.ours: a frozen write replayed each frame by the core

bigpemu_register_event_input_frame.meaning: Registers a callback run once per input poll, used for joypad-sequence cheats.
bigpemu_register_event_input_frame.todo: needs an input hook in the core

bigpemu_register_event_sw_loaded.meaning: Registers the callback run when a cartridge is loaded; the sources compare the loaded hash there and arm the frame callback.
bigpemu_register_event_sw_loaded.ours: the vj_rom_crc32 guard in the pack header

bigpemu_register_setting_bool.meaning: Registers an on/off setting with a label and default; each becomes one toggle.

bigpemu_register_setting_category.meaning: Names the settings group shown for the script; the sources use the game title as the category.

bigpemu_register_setting_int.meaning: Registers a numeric setting with a label, default and range; its value selects what the script writes.
bigpemu_register_setting_int.todo: expand a small value range into one toggle per value

bigpemu_register_setting_int_full.meaning: Numeric setting with explicit default, minimum, maximum and step (a start level or password index in the sources).
bigpemu_register_setting_int_full.ours: bounded constant ranges (at most 64 values) expand to disabled .cht choices; the inactive minimum is off and the last enabled choice wins
bigpemu_register_setting_int_full.todo: runtime-dependent choices, nonconstant or larger ranges require a manual port

bigpemu_set_module_usage_flags.meaning: Sets module flags in bigp_init (the sources only pass a determinism-warning flag); no effect on memory.
bigpemu_set_module_usage_flags.ours: none needed: flags are not translated

bigpemu_unregister_event.meaning: Removes the registered load and frame callbacks in the script's shutdown handler; only runs at unload.

memcpy.meaning: Standard memory copy between script buffers, used to stage data for block writes.
memcpy.todo: block copy cheats need core support in src/core/cheat.c

printf.meaning: Writes to the script log only; no memory or gameplay effect.
printf.ours: none: log output is not reproduced

printf_notify.meaning: Shows an on-screen notification; the sources use it to tell the player whether the loaded cartridge revision is supported.
printf_notify.ours: the app's App::toast, shown when the pack is applied for a game load
